en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a small Northern European town. A vintage bus loaded with luggage and bicycles on the roof is turning onto a dirt road in the foreground. Children run across the street, a cyclist passes, and a crowd stands further back near wooden houses with steep roofs. Tall birch trees and wooden fences line the road. On the left, a shop sign hangs on a wooden building; on the right, another sign stands by a fenced garden in front of a two‑story house.
